user.title: Connect to Sentinel CCTV
user.description: Enter the address of your Sentinel server and an API token. Create one in Sentinel under Settings → API tokens; it is shown only once.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Sentinel CCTV found
zeroconf_confirm.description: Found {name} at {host}. Enter an API token to connect. Create one in Sentinel under Settings → API tokens; it is shown only once.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to Sentinel CCTV
reauth_confirm.description: The token for {name} is no longer accepted. It was probably revoked in Sentinel. Enter a new one.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the server. Check the address, and that Sentinel is running.
error.invalid_auth: That token was rejected. Check it was copied in full, and that it has not been revoked.
error.unsupported_version: This Sentinel server is too old for this integration. Update Sentinel and try again.

abort.already_configured: This Sentinel server is already set up.
abort.already_in_progress: This Sentinel server is already being set up.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the server that announced itself.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: That is a different Sentinel server, not the one being reconnected.

init.title: Sentinel CCTV options
init.description: Sentinel pushes changes over a WebSocket, so this interval only matters while that connection is down.
